events.verdict: Merrill (CLE) steps towards Brunson (NYK) as they come together on the perimeter, and the contact is marginal.
Mitchell (CLE) extends his arms into Towns (NYK) and dislodges him from his rebounding position.
Mitchell (CLE) initiates contact with Brunson's (NYK) arm that causes him to lose control of the ball.
Allen (CLE) dislodges the ball from Brunson (NYK).

Replay review of the foul called on Kolek (NYK) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Kolek dislodges the ball from Mitchell (CLE).  Any ensuing arm contact that occurs after the dislodge is considered incidental.  At the time of the whistle, the Cavaliers had imminent possession and play resumes with Cleveland ball.
Merrill (CLE) establishes himself in Bridges' (NYK) path prior to the contact.
Mitchell (CLE) directly contests Brunson's (NYK) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Brunson's (NYK) hand after the release.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on Mobley (CLE) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Mobley is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Knicks.
Mitchell (CLE) does not overtly, or abruptly, extend his off-arm into Anunoby (NYK) as he removes his left hand from the ball.
Merrill (CLE) and Bridges (NYK) come together at the same spot after Bridges releases the pass, and the contact that occurs is marginal.
Bridges (NYK) legally contests Mitchell's (CLE) jump shot attempt.
Mobley (CLE) commits a take foul on Robinson (NYK).
Mitchell (CLE) enters the lane prior to the release of Robinson's (NYK) free throw attempt.
Mitchell (CLE) gathers the ball on his left foot and takes two legal steps after his gather.
Wade (CLE) commits a take foul on Towns (NYK).
